blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Retail space for sale in South Surrey: storefronts, retail strata units and retail buildings listed on the MLS®. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.
Where South Surrey shops and services are

items.t: Semiahmoo Town Centre, from 16 Avenue (North Bluff Road) to 24 Avenue, is planned by the City as the cultural and commercial heart of South Surrey. Council approved the plan on January 31, 2022; the plan area is 136 hectares (336 acres). ([City of Surrey, Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan](https://www.surrey.ca/renovating-building-development/land-planning-development/land-use-planning/south-surrey-land-use-plans/semiahmoo-town-centre-plan), read November 20, 2026)

Morgan Crossing and Grandview Corners serve the Highway 99 Corridor, and the City plans road improvements along 20 Avenue, including an overpass over Highway 99. ([City of Surrey, Highway 99 Corridor](https://www.surrey.ca/sites/default/files/media/documents/Hwy99CorridorIndustrialArea.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 12 of the 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey were retail & other properties, against 82 across the Lower Mainland. Commercial Edge reports Surrey as one city, so the figure covers all of Surrey, not only South Surrey.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
City of Surrey and White Rock zones that allow retail uses

Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. These are municipal zones, so some apply to parts of Surrey outside South Surrey. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.
